messages:
Nina: quick question  background workers handing off credentials. Should we give them org API keys or mint job-bound delegated tokens?
Ethan: delegated tokens. org keys are too risky and can't be revoked quickly.
Vera: agree, but we need a clear refresh flow for long-running retries. per-job jti + refresh endpoint.
Nina: propose mint API: POST /v1/token/mint {actor, org, scopes, expected_duration}. ttl = min(expected_duration + grace, 1h). include billing_org claim for chargeback.
Ethan: broker resolves rolegraph at mint time and embeds scopes in token. downstream still runs policy checks against token scopes.
Vera: revocation: maintain jti revocation set for high-privilege changes and cheap bloom cache for downstream.
auth-bot: Alert: auth-broker-prod 2026-04-12T08:32:10Z increased 5xx rate.
Nina: fallback: pre-provisioned narrow service-account tokens, never ambient org keys. page ops.
Ethan: I'll draft cache invalidation notes. Vera: I'll write refresh/retry semantics. Nina: I'll assemble mini-RFC and tag @billing + @product.
